cloudlatex.config.enabled: Set true if enable cloudlatex plugin in this project.
cloudlatex.config.projectId: ProjectId. *Do not mistake this value, otherwise your files might be overwritten.
cloudlatex.config.autoCompile: Set true if automatically compile when any files are saved.
cloudlatex.config.supressIcon: Set true to hide cloudlatex icon on the activity bar in the unactivated project.
cloudlatex.config.endpoint: API endpoint. *Do not edit this value under normal usage.
cloudlatex.viewsWelcome.emptyWorkbench:
Connect a Cloud LaTeX project from this sidebar.
[Connect Project](command:cloudlatex.connectProject)
Choose an empty local folder, then click Connect Project again. Enter credentials and select a project, or use its URL/ID if the server does not support project listing.
[Help](https://github.com/cloudlatex-team/cloudlatex-vscode-extension#connect-from-the-sidebar)
cloudlatex.viewsWelcome.inWorkbench:
1. Generate a client ID and token from the account menu on the [Cloud LaTeX Projects page](https://cloudlatex.io/projects).
2. [Connect Project](command:cloudlatex.connectProject) and enter your credentials. Select a project from the list when supported; otherwise choose Connect by Project URL / ID. The extension verifies the project title.
3. Confirm the project and empty local folder to reload and download files. Use the account button to re-login to an existing connection.
[Help](https://github.com/cloudlatex-team/cloudlatex-vscode-extension#connect-from-the-sidebar)
